title: French Hazelnut Cassoulet
description: A classic French dish with a twist, adding hazelnuts for added crunch and flavor. This hearty casserole is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Cook the bacon until crispy, then set aside.
In a large Dutch oven, sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the cooked cassoulet beans, diced tomatoes, and chopped hazelnuts.
Stir well and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and cook for 30 minutes.
Top with crispy bacon and continue cooking for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
